parameters.query:
-- The top 3, ranked by money. Nothing below the £50/yr floor.
-- Anything with a real deadline jumps the queue regardless of value.
SELECT
    id,
    source,
    title,
    detail,
    action_url,
    annual_value_gbp,
    minutes_required,
    due_date
FROM money.actions
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND (annual_value_gbp >= 50 OR due_date IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY
    (due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30) DESC,
    annual_value_gbp DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(one_off_gbp), 0) FROM money.wins)  AS total_one_off_gbp,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(annual_gbp), 0)  FROM money.wins)  AS total_annual_gbp,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM money.wins)                        AS wins_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM money.actions WHERE status = 'open') AS open_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(annual_cost_gbp), 0)
       FROM money.subscriptions WHERE status = 'active')     AS recurring_annual_gbp;
